stories.message: No Stripe key is configured on this deploy, so per the app's own documented design checkout never reaches a payment step and places the order directly with paymentStatus 'pay_at_store' (confirmed on the confirmation page: 'Payment: Pay at store'). Testing a real Stripe Checkout Session requires the owner's live Stripe key — a real third party this QA pass cannot use. Everything short of reaching Stripe (basket -> checkout -> order placed) was exercised and worked.

After placing a guest order, customer is taken to /order/:code showing order number, status (Received), payment state (Pay at store), fulfilment (Pickup), estimated ready time, placed date, full item lines and total. Run anonymously as guest customer (no account in this app).
evidence: page_text: 'Order confirmation / Order z9ln1-q1... / Status Received / Payment Pay at store / Fulfilment Pickup / Estimated ready 8:13 PM / Items ...'

stories.message: Signed in as owner (password admin account) on /manage/orders, read the queue, then placed a new guest order from a separate anonymous page without ever reloading or re-navigating the owner's page, and a re-read of the owner page's text showed the new order (#2mwMjKlB, 'Live Stream QA') at the top of the list — proving it arrived live. Items, pickup/delivery and payment status are shown per order.
evidence: Owner page text before: queue without #2mwMjKlB
anonymous page: POST /CheckoutApi/order 201 for Live Stream QA
Owner page text after (no navigate call in between): '#2mwMjKlB ... Live Stream QA · 07700900777 ... Payment: Pay at store' at top of queue

stories.message: Signed in as owner on /manage/menu, opened Edit on 'Cola' and clicked Save (both with an edited price and, on retry, with no changes at all) — every attempt gets POST /MenuAdminApi/update 400, and the page shows 'Bad Request' inline. The item is never updated.

Signed in as owner on /manage/orders, clicked 'Mark preparing' on one order and 'Mark collected' on a different order — both calls hit POST /OrderAdminApi/status and return 400 Bad Request; the page shows 'Bad Request' inline and the order's status does not change. Reproduced on two separate orders.
evidence: POST /OrderAdminApi/status 400 (read_network), twice on different order ids
page_text showing 'Bad Request' banner above the still-unchanged queue

defects.message: Both admin mutation endpoints that take an identifier plus a changed field (MenuAdminApi/update, OrderAdminApi/status) return 400 Bad Request on every call observed, including a no-op edit-and-save with unchanged values. StoreSettingsApi's PUT (a single-row save with no id in the body) succeeded (200), which narrows the defect to whatever these two endpoints have in common — likely how the item/order id or the changed field is validated or shaped in the request body.

notes: Owner sign-in used the seeded admin/password account via the app's own /login 'Sign in with a password' path (there is no owner test account marked signIn:link). Member and member2 link accounts were used only for the roleEscalation cross-probe. Email send is correctly disabled (emailSignIn:false, no Resend key) and the sign-in page says so; this is expected per the task brief, not a defect.

accessTest.reason: the plan makes no resource owner-scoped
